assessment: The authors dissect and reconstitute the cytosolic steps of biogenesis of mitochondrial signal-anchored membrane proteins, focusing on post-translational precursor recognition by cytosolic chaperones and their subsequent transfer to mitochondrial import receptors. These are crucial events in order to assist proper protein biogenesis while preventing aggregation and its downstream consequences. The study is an important contribution to the understanding of cytosolic events in the biogenesis of mitochondrial proteins and will be of relevance for researchers in the fields of chaperone and mitochondrial biology as well as for cell biologists studying the biogenesis of membrane proteins.
